name: Skeleton Parameter Minimization for Ray Intersection
aliases: Rational Function Root Finding for SCALIS
definition: A method to find the intersection of a ray with a scale-invariant integral surface (SCALIS) by minimizing the squared distance from the ray to the skeleton curve, normalized by the field value, instead of directly solving the implicit surface equation. This avoids complex sphere-cone intersection logic.
summary: Skeleton Parameter Minimization for Ray Intersection computes SCALIS ray intersections by minimizing normalized distance to the skeleton curve, offering superior numerical stability and efficiency over direct implicit surface solving.
